title: SEC2.4: jmap_post unnecessary vec allocation for response body without Content-Length
description:
watch.rs lines 540-541 (jmap_post function): when Content-Length header is absent, response body is read via read_to_end into a Vec. This Vec is allocated optimistically and may be larger than needed, especially for large responses.

However, this is acceptable since Content-Length is always present in JMAP responses per RFC 7231. But the pattern should prefer Vec::with_capacity(len) when len is known.

Impact: Low; mostly affects cases where Content-Length is missing (rare in practice).
Location: watch.rs lines 535-543.
